current_example.title: Example: Evaluating an Expression With Two Absolute Values

q-215791.name: Question 1
q-215791.worked_solution:
We substitute $y=-3$ and then evaluate the absolute value before we simplify the rest of the expression:

$$
\begin{aligned}|2y+7{|}^{6} & = \\ |2(-3)+7{|}^{6} & = \\ |-6+7{|}^{6} & = \\ |1{|}^{6} & = \\ {1}^{6} & = \\ 1\end{aligned}
$$

fields.input_html: 0

q-215791.html:
Question 1
?
If y=−3, then |2y+7|6=
0
.
Submit
Incorrect
EXPLANATION

We substitute y=−3 and then evaluate the absolute value before we simplify the rest of the expression:

|2y+7|6=|2(−3)+7|6=|−6+7|6=|1|6=16=1
q-215791.knowledge_point: Evaluating an Expression With One Absolute Value

q-215788.name: Question 2
q-215788.worked_solution:
We substitute $x=-2$ and then evaluate the absolute value before we simplify the rest of the expression:

$$
\begin{aligned}|{x}^{3}-x|+2x & = \\ |(-2)^{3}-(-2)|+2(-2) & = \\ |-8+2|-4 & = \\ |-6|-4 & = \\ 6-4 & = \\ 2\end{aligned}
$$

fields.input_html: 2

q-215788.html:
Question 2
?
If x=−2, then |x3−x|+2x=
2
.
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

We substitute x=−2 and then evaluate the absolute value before we simplify the rest of the expression:

|x3−x|+2x=|(−2)3−(−2)|+2(−2)=|−8+2|−4=|−6|−4=6−4=2
q-215788.knowledge_point: Evaluating an Expression With One Absolute Value

q-212311.name: Question 3
q-212311.worked_solution:
We substitute $y=10$ and then evaluate the absolute value before we simplify the rest of the expression:

$$
\begin{aligned}|y-15|+2-y & = \\ |10-15|+2-10 & = \\ |-5|+2-10 & = \\ 5+2-10 & = \\ -3\end{aligned}
$$

fields.input_html: −3

q-215798.name: Question 4
q-215798.worked_solution:
We substitute $x=-7$ and then evaluate the absolute values before we simplify the rest of the expression:

$$
\begin{aligned}|x+2|+|x| & = \\ |-7+2|+|-7| & = \\ |-5|+|-7| & = \\ 5+7 & = \\ 12 & \end{aligned}
$$

fields.input_html: 12

q-215798.html:
Question 4
?

12
.

EXPLANATION

We substitute x=−7 and then evaluate the absolute values before we simplify the rest of the expression:

|x+2|+|x|=|−7+2|+|−7|=|−5|+|−7|=5+7=12
q-215798.knowledge_point: Evaluating an Expression With Two Absolute Values

q-212318.name: Question 5
q-212318.worked_solution:
We substitute $t=0$ and then evaluate the absolute values before we simplify the rest of the expression:

$$
\begin{aligned}|t-2|-|t+3| & = \\ |0-2|-|0+3| & = \\ |-2|-|3| & = \\ 2-3 & = \\ -1 & \end{aligned}
$$

fields.input_html: 1

q-212318.html:

|t−2|−|t+3|=|0−2|−|0+3|=|−2|−|3|=2−3=−1
q-212318.knowledge_point: Evaluating an Expression With Two Absolute Values

q-131823.name: Question 6
q-131823.worked_solution:
We substitute $y=3$ and then evaluate the absolute values before we simplify the rest of the expression:

$$
\begin{aligned}|{2}^{y}|-5|{y}^{2}| & = \\ |{2}^{3}|-5|{3}^{2}| & = \\ |8|-5|9| & = \\ 8-5(9) & = \\ 8-45 & = \\ -37\end{aligned}
$$

q-215801.name: Question 7
q-215801.worked_solution:
We substitute $y=-2$ and then evaluate the absolute values before we simplify the rest of the expression:

$$
\begin{aligned}|3-{y}^{4}|+|y|-8 & = \\ |3-(-2)^{4}|+|-2|-8 & = \\ |3-16|+|-2|-8 & = \\ |-13|+|-2|-8 & = \\ 13+2-8 & = \\ 7 & \end{aligned}
$$

fields.input_html: 7

q-215801.html:
Question 7
?

7
.
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

We substitute y=−2 and then evaluate the absolute values before we simplify the rest of the expression:

|3−y4|+|y|−8=|3−(−2)4|+|−2|−8=|3−16|+|−2|−8=|−13|+|−2|−8=13+2−8=7
